simple.meaning: רְעוּת (rᵉʻûwth) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a female associate ; generally an additional one.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 11:2. The surrounding context includes commandment, Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְעוּת (H7468) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: רְעוּת (rᵉʻûwth) / H7468 is traced through Exodus 11:2, Esther 1:19, Isaiah 34:15, Isaiah 34:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a female associate ; generally an additional one
definitions.full: H7468. reuth I. רְעוּת noun feminine fellow (-woman); — suffix in reciprocal phrase רְעוּתָהּ מֵאֵת אִשָּׁה Exod 11:2 (E) each from her fellow (|| רֵעֵהוּ מֵאֵת אִישׁ , compare II. רֵעַ 3 ); compare Jer 9:19 ; of birds of prey ( דַיּוֺת ) Isa 34:15 compare 34:16 ; people under figure of sheep Zech 11:9 ; רְעוּתָהּ Est 1:19 = another than she (compare 1Sam 15:28 II. רֵעַ 2 ).
